completeness_assessment.issue: No completeness issues found. All tables, columns, relationships, and metrics are fully documented and cross-referenced between the semantic model and data glossary.

accuracy_assessment.issue: The semantic model's ai_context contains critical instructions about preventing double-counting when joining orders to order_items (order-level monetary fields will duplicate per line item), but the data glossary field descriptions for orders.subtotal, orders.discount_amount, orders.tax_amount, orders.shipping_fee, and orders.total_amount do not explicitly warn users about this aggregation risk.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Add a warning note to the glossary descriptions of order-level monetary fields (subtotal, discount_amount, tax_amount, shipping_fee, total_amount) stating: "Order-level measure. When joining orders to order_items, this value will duplicate for each line item. Do not sum after join without deduplication." This ensures users consulting only the glossary receive the same critical guidance present in the semantic model.

efficiency_assessment.issue: System metadata fields (_source_system, _batch_id, _loaded_at) have identical descriptions repeated across all 7 tables in the data glossary. For example, "_source_system" is described as "Identifier of the source system from which the [table] record was loaded" with only the table name varying.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Centralize system metadata field definitions in a shared glossary section or reference document, then reference that shared definition from each table. This reduces maintenance burden and ensures consistency when system metadata standards evolve.

efficiency_assessment.issue: While the semantic model metric expressions are well-structured, the system metadata field descriptions in the glossary could be more efficiently maintained through a shared reference rather than verbatim repetition across tables.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider implementing a glossary template or shared definition library for common technical metadata fields that appear across multiple tables, reducing redundancy and improving maintainability.
